claims.sentence: Although research has shown no significant differences in the effectiveness of continuous daily intake (e.g., 3-5 g per day) versus loading protocols (20 g/day for 5-7 days followed by a maintenance dose), adopting a continuous daily creatine supplementation protocol is a more practical and convenient approach compared to traditional loading protocols.
